g.text: A: all populations included; 95% independent-history Hoeffding bounds. Extinction is not zero trait change.
B: S = initial state; C = visitor history; I = their non-additive combination. N/E = not evaluable.
Shares describe repeat-averaged cells; finite-repeat noise is not removed. Within-cell noise is reported in the summary.
